description: This script performs a connectivity test to Google Gemini AI using the google.genai SDK. It loads an API key from environment variables, attempts to import the SDK, and sends a simple prompt ('Hello, Gemini!') to verify the setup. It then prints the response or appropriate error messages if credentials are missing or invalid. The script is designed to be run either directly or as a module for testing purposes.

methods.name: None _print_header()
methods.description: Prints a header message indicating the start of the Gemini connectivity test.

methods.name: Optional[str] _check_sdk()
methods.description: Checks if the 'google.genai' SDK is installed and importable, returning an error message if not.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_api_key(env_var: str = "GEMINI_API_KEY")
methods.description: Retrieves the GEMINI_API_KEY from environment variables, defaulting to 'GEMINI_API_KEY'.

methods.name: str _safe_one_liner(text: str)
methods.description: Collapses a multi-line string into a single line, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: int run_test(model: str = "gemini-1.5-pro")
methods.description: Main function that performs the connectivity test by sending a prompt to Gemini and printing the response or errors.

ctags.name: genai_types
ctags.pattern: /^        from google.genai import types as genai_types  # type: ignore$/
